contracts.status: Expanded design proposals. No runtime implementation, numerical balance sign-off, art generation or equipment migration.
contracts.basis: Current one-hero/one-foe Speed timeline, three selectable active/passive slots. Twelve signature choices plus existing six class tools per hero is a deliberate expanded proposal following owner creative brief; the historical fourteen-total rule is not silently treated as live eighteen-card support.
contracts.units: U is pre-crit hero ability power. H means a subsequent completed hero action; F means a foe opportunity, including a skipped foe turn for generic status expiry/ticks. Printed cooldown decreases at hero-turn start under core rules, with existing Parry/Focus refunds. Token durations count subsequent actions, never their creation action; expiry occurs after their final eligible action. A duration stated in enemy moves instead lasts through completion of the next actual attack, with a maximum two-F timeout to avoid windup/skip immortality, unless an explicitly paid multi-move exception states its longer finite timeout.
contracts.actions: Each active consumes one hero opportunity. Passives occupy a slot and never add an action, free strike, equipment slot or autonomous defence. Attack/Parry/Dodge remain core buttons. Optional passive choices are displayed as mutually exclusive intentions on Attack before committing, not a fourth ability button. A passive choice consumes opening tokens and resource before contact; ordinary Attack earns one primary resource after contact. An Attack may choose at most one token-consuming passive spend across the kit; passive spend is not an active expenditure for Star refunds.
contracts.resource: Every expanded hero starts at zero, with the displayed native cap; chosen Attack gains one native resource after contact unless its own mode explicitly forgoes that income. Source-specific passive rewards are consumed even at cap. All state resets each fight. Costs and optional modes are paid once before contact, from gross opening resources; passive spending is not an active cost for Star refunds.
contracts.damage: One direct budget and at most one explicit bounded derived payout per action. Multi-hit presentation shares one timing grade, crit budget and proc allowance. Derived stored payouts snapshot U when authored, clear source first, cannot crit or amplify a second time, and cannot generate resources, new tokens, Curse storage or on-hit Star procs. Optional direct modifiers add within a proposed +40% U ceiling, not successive multipliers. Every card has a useful fallback without a special token; no free token on its own consumption action. Timing’s +0.15U bonus is included in the +0.40U optional direct-modifier ceiling. Alternate branches explicitly printing a larger resource-priced base are separate bases, not modifiers; each still takes one grade and one action budget. Protection-plus-damage outputs are explicit starting allocations for real-core measurement, not proof of equal value. For percentage kit bonuses, convert the stated percentage of the selected action’s printed direct base (A for basic Attack, U coefficient for a signature) into raw damage, add flat-U held charges and timing, then cap the total optional kit increment at 0.40U. Multiple charges do not each get that ceiling. Armour ignore is multiplicative under core caps and remains physical-only. Core gear, crit, native Mark and equipped Star multipliers stay in their existing pipeline; this kit-only ceiling does not silently retune them. Any overflowing authored bonus is visibly capped, never banked.
contracts.timing: Four new signatures per hero use the existing ring input. Good gives written baseline, Miss uses core reduced damage, Perfect adds 0.15U to the single direct action budget unless the card explicitly names another Perfect result; then that replaces the numerical rider. Utility/status application is not silently cancelled on Miss. No bonus turn, cost refund, passive rearm or control-lock bypass on Perfect. Explicit original exceptions: Tobin Oathstrike and Pip Lanternburst may refund one actually spent native unit on Perfect instead of the ordinary +0.15U direct rider. Combined with Banked Coal or any other refund, the aggregate refund cannot exceed one or the gross actual cost. Zero-cost use refunds nothing. New kits retain the no-Perfect-refund default. Expanded roster: each of all34 has four timed signatures; untimed actives, preparation and recovery retain lower-attention options. Shared Power Strike, Flurry, Heavy Strike and Frost Shard also expose pooled timing. Equal access does not imply equal measured difficulty.
contracts.defence: Parry and Dodge always require manual per-hit input. Guard is proposed 25% mitigation during the next enemy attack, does not replace either choice, expires at completion or after two F. Ward replaces with greater remaining amount, never sums, subject to core Ward cap/gear scaling; card-authored amounts are maximum-HP percentages. Heal uses maximum HP, capped by missing HP; no overheal-to-Ward except actual equipped gear rule. A status-blocking Ward has one eligibility per application; refresh cannot rearm it. Ward lasts three F using the core expiry clock. A greater authored replacement updates amount and duration; a smaller application keeps remaining amount and may refresh duration to three F but never rearms a status-block eligibility. Cleared/expired Ward removes that eligibility. Ward cannot exceed the core cap after gear. A card explicitly granting two moves of Guard is a paid exception: at most two actual enemy attacks, three-F timeout. Explicit two-F Wards keep the shorter duration; other Wards use three F. A card-defined status-block instance cannot rearm by refresh.
contracts.statuses: Reuse core Mark, Pin, Sunder, Weaken, Exposed, Chill, Burn, Bleed and Venom caps/durations. Exposed is a core hero-action-clock setup, not a foe-F timer: application after contact sets e.exposed to 2; the creation action’s end reduces it to 1, so it survives the intervening foe turn for the next chosen hero action. It is consumed by the first eligible direct payoff, or expires at that next hero action’s end. Printed next-action Exposed means this exact core window. Expanded proposals tag directly selected damaging actives and basic Attack as eligible payoffs; extending eligibility beyond current core tags is an explicit implementation dependency, not already live behaviour. One eligible self-cleanse removes one existing Burn, Bleed, Venom, Chill, Blind or Weaken in the player-selected eligible family, never cooldowns, control lock, fight-only vows or beneficial setup; expanding live turnCleanse beyond DoTs is an explicit implementation dependency. Applying Chill three invokes core Freeze, clears Chill and meets core lock. Rejected control gives no skip/freeze-success reward. Stun/Freeze attempts use boss Stagger and charge-breaking core; no guaranteed interruption, even when a card name sounds decisive.
contracts.stars: Preserve distinction between currently implemented 43 Stars and revised dossier Star proposals. Structural interaction review uses revised definitions; no claim that generic-resource eligibility is implemented for new heroes. Counters remain core sure crits, Parry per-hit refunds remain live: kit rewards whole moves, not individual hits. No new kit hook fires recursively from Star-generated damage, status, Ward, counter or passive spender. Actual full-gross active spending is snapshotted before any Banked Coal refund.
contracts.shared: Existing six shared class tools are available; no shared tool supplies a hero-specific token unless explicitly revised in this deliverable. H finisher third-opportunity gate uses actual core heroOps, unlike token expiry which uses completed actions. Class/evolution names in dossiers are proposals where they differ from accepted names. All held hero Openings/charges are source-labelled. Shared Heavy Strike may consume an eligible Opening for only its printed shared payout; it replaces the signature payout and cannot attach that charge again. Generic Exposed is a separate core foe status and follows its native next-payoff rules. A source-specific vow/watch/line token is not automatically an Opening.
contracts.equipment: Every hero carries a lantern. Mage combat gear target is staff+tome, still pending crafting/migration. No physical thrown assets, unarmed kits, movement requirement, party healing, summons, extra enemies, brand-new weapon families or lightning damage type. Abilities use held weapons and artist-authored overlays; no new art integrated.
contracts.attackTypes: Proposed new basic Attacks: Warriors/Rangers physical held-weapon contact or arrows; Mages holy spells in the existing damage pipeline, with artist-authored thread/clock/prism/ledger/conductor visuals. This is an explicit provisional type mapping, not an implemented arcane/lightning/death resistance system. Fire/frost actives retain printed types. Armour penetration only benefits physical packets; holy Attack riders use direct power instead. Original proposed Attack types are listed per hero; Inga uses physical held-staff contact to make Sunder/penetration meaningful while her signature spells stay frost. Ragna uses existing holy witchlight for direct magical packets and separate Venom for poison; no unsupported poison-resistance system is implied. Old spell effects with no printed type use that hero’s declared spell theme; ordinary sword/spear/maul/axe actions stay physical, while explicitly elemental strikes keep their stated type.
contracts.curseArbitration: One foe Curse slot, source-labelled Mab or Hex. Applying either discards the other’s storage, age and unused eligibility. Generic Nova/Final Word may consume either for stored damage under that source’s cap, clearing source-specific maturity first; never awards Mab’s maturity direct rider. Mab-specific consumption may act only on Mab-authored Curse; Hex cannot activate its maturity or passive rewards.

heroes.lore: Mab repaired mourning clothes until the dead began leaving instructions in their hems. She does not raise them. She finishes the promises they cannot.
heroes.visual: A broad older woman with a hooked nose, deep brown skin and a single white braid. Indigo fitted coat, ivory seam markings, spindle-shaped staff; amber lantern and stitched black tome.
heroes.mechanic: One woven Curse matures after a real defended-or-landed enemy attack finishes. Cut it for pressure, unravel it for safety, or invest in its natural release.

tokens.Mab Curse: One Curse using the generic Curse status, lasts three F unless stated otherwise; matures after one completed actual damaging enemy move after application. A windup, skipped turn or DoT tick cannot mature it. Storage is 20% of subsequent hero-authored direct damage actually dealt, capped 0.6U; Star damage, DoT, counters and derived payouts are excluded. Natural expiry releases existing storage once without mature bonus, then clears. Consuming clears before contact; subsequent fresh Curse cannot inherit storage. Mab-specific readers/spenders/rewards ignore a Hex-authored Curse; only Mab-authored application has maturity eligibility. Shared replacement/consumption arbitration is defined globally.

cards.name: Last Stitch
cards.effect: 0.5U holy spell and apply one Mab Curse: store up to 0.6U from subsequent eligible direct damage under the Curse contract. Replacing it discards old storage and maturity.

cards.name: Cut the Thread
cards.effect: 0.8U holy spell; optionally consume Mab Curse for its stored derived damage, capped 0.6U. A mature Curse adds 0.2U authored direct power; an immature one can still be collected.

cards.name: Unpick the Knot
cards.effect: Consume Mab Curse for one-F Weaken and 6% Ward, or, without a Curse, receive 6% Ward only. Mature Curse gives two-F Weaken instead. No damage payout.

cards.name: Seam Allowance
cards.effect: 0.7U holy spell. Keep existing Curse and add one F duration, maximum four remaining; with no Curse, gain Guard instead. Extending never grants a maturation reward.

cards.name: Spindle Turn
cards.effect: 1.2U holy spell. If opening Curse is mature, choose to retain it for continued storage or consume it for one Stun attempt, discarding stored damage; rejection still consumes it.

cards.name: Keep the Pattern
cards.effect: Guard through the next move and protect one existing Mab Curse from natural expiry during that move only. Protection does not prevent replacement or consumption; mature timing is unchanged.

cards.name: Needle Through
cards.effect: 1.1U holy spell. Consume a mature Curse for next-action Exposed instead of its stored damage; otherwise retain the Curse and deal 1.3U total.

cards.name: Mend by Hand
cards.effect: Heal 5% maximum HP and clear one eligible self-debuff. May consume Curse for 8% heal instead of clearing; lost storage gives no extra damage.

cards.name: The Last Unravelling
cards.effect: 1.5U holy spell. Consume Curse for its stored derived damage; a mature Curse additionally gives Guard after contact. Available from third H.

cards.name: Patient Hands
cards.effect: First natural maturation of each freshly applied Mab Curse grants one Thread, once per application even at cap. Attack may pay one Thread to apply an empty two-F Mab Curse after damage if none exists; its own contact is not stored.

cards.name: Loose Hem
cards.effect: First whole manually defended move while a Mab Curse exists grants a 6% Ward after the move, once per Curse application. Replacement discards unused eligibility; extending never resets it.

cards.name: Threadbare
cards.effect: Attack may consume opening Mab Curse for its stored derived damage capped 0.4U, or pay one Thread and consume it to Weaken for one F. No payout from the Attack itself is recorded into the consumed Curse.

artReview.comment: Love it. Great design. Made me realise how we need more different race characters.
artReview.action: Preserve the liked spindle/thread design. Broaden ethnicity and facial diversity across future additions; do not recolour existing approved characters to satisfy a quota.

heroes.name: Peregrine Clocks
heroes.title: The Watchmaker
heroes.lore: Peregrine repaired the village clock until it began striking for people who had not yet died. He dismantled it, kept one spring, and went to find who had wound it.
heroes.visual: A thin older man with a long face, deep brown skin and short tightly coiled silver hair and a close, textured silver beard. Prussian-blue tailored work coat, straight staff with one enclosed clock dial, indexed brass tome and amber pocket lantern.
heroes.mechanic: Move one real cooldown turn between two cooling actives, then decide whether a receipt is worth collecting now. A clockmaker manipulates availability, never grants a free turn.

tokens.Receipt: One token expires after two subsequent H. No growth from repeated transfers or donated duration.
tokens.Appointment: One token matures after one subsequent hero action completes; expires after two subsequent H. Consecutive hero turns count normally; no scheduling change.

cards.name: Borrow Tomorrow
cards.effect: Choose two different other equipped actives both already cooling: add one cooldown turn to donor, subtract one from recipient. Donor cannot exceed printed cooldown plus one. Cannot transfer again until a later chosen Attack resets the transfer lock. If Clockstrike is the donor, establish Receipt. If no legal pair exists, choose before payment a next-Attack +0.2U direct-power token lasting two H instead; no Receipt.

cards.name: Clockstrike
cards.effect: 1.1U holy spell. May consume opening Receipt for +0.25U direct power; keep it for a later Clockstrike or a protective Attack instead.

cards.name: Stop the Pendulum
cards.effect: 10% Ward and clear one eligible self-debuff. No automatic cooldown change; can be a cooling donor or recipient.

cards.name: Set the Alarm
cards.effect: 0.5U holy spell. Establish Appointment for the next two H. It matures after exactly one subsequent H completes; replace to discard its age.

cards.name: Meet the Hour
cards.effect: 1.3U holy spell. Consume a mature Appointment for +0.2U direct power, or consume an immature one for Guard after contact. A miss reduces damage but still consumes the chosen token.

cards.name: Wind by Hand
cards.effect: Gain two Ticks and Guard through the next enemy move. This is a paid opportunity, not a cooldown refund or transfer-lock reset.

cards.name: Second Hand
cards.effect: 1U holy spell; reduce one other selected cooling active by one CD turn, then add one CD turn to this ability after setting its printed cooldown. One exchange; cannot target itself.

cards.name: Close the Case
cards.effect: Heal 5% HP and gain 6% Ward. May cancel Receipt or Appointment to clear one eligible self-debuff; cancel at most one, without damage.

cards.name: The Hour Held Open
cards.effect: 1.6U holy spell. Consume Receipt for +0.25U direct power, or mature Appointment for +0.2U and one-F Weaken. Choose at most one. Available from third H.

cards.name: Escapement
cards.effect: Every second chosen Attack establishes one Receipt after contact, replacing any old one. A Borrow Tomorrow receipt is the same token. Attack may consume an opening Receipt and pay one Tick for +0.2U direct power; it cannot collect and create a receipt on the same Attack.

cards.name: On the Minute
cards.effect: A chosen Attack after a signature active gains one extra Tick, once/action. Alternatively every third consecutive Attack gains one extra Tick. Signature use resets the consecutive counter; bonuses never stack.

cards.name: Clockwork Habit
cards.effect: Attack may pay one Tick and consume an opening Receipt for 6% Ward after contact instead of Escapement’s direct-power rider. Consumption resolves before any new receipt creation; a consuming Attack cannot create another Receipt.

artReview.comment: He needs hair that's of African origin. He has white guy hair (facial and head). I like that he's old though.
artReview.action: Preserve elderly identity and skin tone; revise head hair to short tightly coiled silver hair and beard to an appropriately textured close silver beard. Match both views.

heroes.name: Tamsin Rook
heroes.title: The Bellsword
heroes.lore: Tamsin learned sword forms from the tolling of a cracked watch bell. She still counts the missing note, waiting for the day she can bring its maker home.
heroes.visual: Tall, strong woman with a square jaw, close black undercut and a burn scar along one cheek. Clean burgundy fencing coat over compact armour; small round shield and warm belt lantern. No bell weapon.
heroes.mechanic: A bellsword with a steady rhythm and an optional timing flourish: Perfect creates Accent, but ordinary Attack also supplies preparation at an action cost.

heroes.name: Sable Quill
heroes.title: The Ash Reader
heroes.lore: Sable was a plague-house clerk who remembered every name the town tried to erase. Her cures have become sharper since the town stopped asking politely.
heroes.visual: A tall, angular woman in her fifties, olive skin, severe straight nose and tightly bound black-and-white hair. Cream high-collared coat with plum sleeves; ringed staff, ledger tome and brass lantern.
heroes.mechanic: A diagnostic mage who turns an actual cleanse into a choice between remedy pressure and prevention. A clean fight still has a deliberate, smaller preparation route.

tokens.Remedy: One token with full or prepared strength, expires after three subsequent H. Actual status removal is the only source of full Remedy. Replacement discards old strength. Ward consumption or blocked statuses cannot create full Remedy.

cards.name: Read the Fever
cards.effect: Clear one eligible self-debuff and establish full Remedy only if actually removed. If none is removable, choose before payment between 8% Ward or establishing prepared Remedy. Only one route; no cleanse and preparation together.

cards.name: Bitter Cure
cards.effect: 1U holy spell. Consume Remedy for +0.3U full / +0.15U prepared direct power, or for Weaken lasting two F full / one F prepared. Choose one rider.

cards.name: Write the Prescription
cards.effect: 0.5U holy spell; establish prepared Remedy after contact. Replacement never converts prepared into full.

cards.name: Preventive Seal
cards.effect: 10% Ward. While this Ward survives, block the next eligible harmful self-status application, once. Consume Remedy for 12% full / 11% prepared Ward instead; no immediate cleanse.

cards.name: Measured Dose
cards.effect: 1.3U holy spell. Consume Remedy to Mark for three F full / two F prepared instead of retaining it.

cards.name: Rule Out
cards.effect: 0.8U holy spell and one-F Weaken. Consume full Remedy to extend Weaken to two F, or prepared Remedy for 6% Ward instead.

cards.name: Check the Pulse
cards.effect: Heal 5% HP. Consume full Remedy to heal 8% instead, or prepared Remedy for 6% Ward after the ordinary heal.

cards.name: Ink Against Fever
cards.effect: 1.1U holy spell. Consume Remedy for next-action Exposed, full or prepared; a full Remedy also clears one eligible self-debuff. No new Remedy is created.

cards.name: No Cause for Mourning
cards.effect: 1.5U holy spell. Consume Remedy for +0.3U full / +0.15U prepared direct power, or 10% full / 6% prepared Ward instead. Available from third H.

cards.name: Clean Hands
cards.effect: Every third chosen Attack establishes prepared Remedy after contact if none exists. Attack may pay one Reagent and consume opening Remedy for 8% full / 6% prepared Ward. A spending Attack does not prepare another Remedy.

cards.name: Clinical Eye
cards.effect: Attack while holding opening Remedy gains +15% direct action damage. Consuming Remedy before contact forfeits this held-preparation bonus. No stacking per status cleansed or armour penetration on magical damage.

cards.name: Steady Hands
cards.effect: First whole enemy move fully defended manually after a chosen Attack earns one Reagent, once until another Attack rearms it. If Remedy exists, Attack may instead pay one Reagent and consume it for one-F Weaken, forfeiting Clean Hands’ Ward.

artReview.comment: Wow Sable Quill looks exceptional! Big fan of this one.
artReview.action: Preserve the strongly liked face, colours and costume. Earlier reviewer suggestions do not override this direct feedback; any ledger/focus change must preserve the identity the owner likes.

heroes.title: The Pale Advocate
heroes.lore: Adela settles the debts of people buried without their names. She will not bring a soul back; she will make the living acknowledge what they owe.

heroes.mechanic: A pale advocate whose fixed authored Debt can be collected, forgiven or used to close an account. Nothing copies arbitrary damage or runs a second crit calculation.

tokens.Debt: One fixed authored 0.2U or 0.3U token expires after three subsequent H, without a natural damage payout. Its value is snapshotted when recorded and never multiplied again on collection. Consuming clears before contact.

cards.name: Final Account
cards.effect: 1.1U holy spell; may consume Debt for its fixed derived payout capped 0.4U, or preserve it. No additional scaling from damage previously dealt.

cards.name: Stay the Claim
cards.effect: Guard through next move. Consume Debt for 10% Ward instead of Guard; gives no damage payout.

cards.name: Write It Off
cards.effect: Consume Debt to clear one eligible self-debuff and gain 8% Ward. Without Debt or without a removable status, choose a 6% Ward fallback before payment; fallback does not consume Debt.

cards.name: Notice Served
cards.effect: 0.9U holy spell and two-F Mark. With no Debt, may instead record 0.2U Debt after a positive HP hit, forgoing Mark.

cards.name: Seal the Account
cards.effect: 1.2U holy spell; consume Debt for next-action Exposed, discarding its stored damage. Otherwise retain it and gain one-F Weaken.

cards.name: A Last Courtesy
cards.effect: Heal 5% HP. Consume Debt for 8% instead; forfeit collection damage.

cards.name: No Appeal
cards.effect: 1.3U holy spell. Consume Debt for one Stun attempt instead of its payout; the base spell remains useful on rejection.

cards.name: Close the Book
cards.effect: 1.6U holy spell. Consume Debt for its fixed derived payout, or retain it and gain Guard after contact. Available from third H.

cards.name: Witness Mark
cards.effect: Every third chosen Attack records 0.2U Debt after a positive HP hit if none exists. A consuming Attack cannot record fresh Debt. No recording from counters, Star packets or ward absorption.

cards.name: Merciful Ledger
cards.effect: Attack may pay one Writ and cancel opening Debt to clear one eligible self-debuff, or gain 6% Ward instead. Select before contact; with no eligible debuff the cleanse choice is unavailable.

cards.name: No Double Entry
cards.effect: Attack may pay one Writ and consume opening Debt for its fixed derived payout capped 0.3U, or keep it and gain +15% direct Attack damage. Derived payouts do not record or crit.

artReview.action: Retain Adela. Refine the closed-arch staff head while preserving the liked overall design and violet lantern.

heroes.title: The Winter Arrow
heroes.lore: Ysabet charts the roads by listening to ice crack under distant feet. She hunts the thing that has begun walking across lakes without leaving a sound.
heroes.visual: A heavyset older woman with weathered copper skin, narrow dark eyes and a short iron-grey braid. Deep teal wool coat, white cuff lining, long ash bow; frosted-glass lantern.
heroes.mechanic: A patient winter archer who decides between preserving Chill for reliable shots and spending it to attempt control. Ordinary shots work even when a boss cannot be frozen.

tokens.Chill: Use the existing foe Chill status, not a parallel hero stack. Core threshold is three; two-F expiry is refreshed by adding a stack. White Silence consumes two before attempting control, even while control locked; no bonus for a rejected attempt.

cards.name: Rime Arrow
cards.effect: 0.8U physical arrow and one Chill after contact. Chill uses the core threshold of three; adding the third invokes normal Freeze and clears Chill.

cards.name: White Silence
cards.effect: 1.2U physical arrow. May consume exactly two opening Chill for one Freeze attempt instead of retaining them. Fewer than two: ordinary shot only; control rejection still consumes the two.

cards.name: Glass Fletching
cards.effect: 1.1U physical arrow. If opening Chill exists, ignore 30% armour without consuming it; otherwise apply one-F Pin instead.

cards.name: Snowblind
cards.effect: 0.7U physical arrow and one-F Weaken. May consume one opening Chill for two-F Weaken instead; no new Chill.

cards.name: Thawline
cards.effect: 1.4U physical arrow. Consume one opening Chill for +0.2U direct power, or keep Chill and gain 6% Ward after contact.

cards.name: Still Water
cards.effect: Guard through next enemy move and 6% Ward. May pay one additional Rime to add one Chill to the foe after preparation instead of gaining Ward; this can reach the core Freeze threshold.

cards.name: Cold Notch
cards.effect: 0.5U physical arrow and gain one Rime after contact. With no opening Chill, apply one Chill after contact; never add Chill if any already exists.

cards.name: Ice at the Sill
cards.effect: 1U physical arrow; consume one opening Chill for next-action Exposed, or retain Chill for 1.2U total direct damage.

cards.name: The Long White Road
cards.effect: 1.7U physical arrow; may consume two opening Chill for one Freeze attempt instead of half-armour penetration. With no Chill, normal 1.7U shot; penetration requires at least one retained Chill. Available from third H.

cards.name: Clear Ice
cards.effect: Attack against opening Chill ignores 20% remaining armour. If consuming Chill before contact leaves none, no penetration applies.

cards.name: Cold Watch
cards.effect: Every third chosen Attack adds one Chill after contact unless that Attack consumed opening Chill. The third-Attack counter resets even when application is suppressed. Core threshold, lock and duration apply; a skipped foe turn is not an extra application.

cards.name: Winter Patience
cards.effect: Attack may pay one Rime and consume one opening Chill for 8% Ward after contact, or retain Chill and pay one Rime for one-F Weaken. No second arrow or same-action refund.

artReview.comment: Love Ysabet but her bow is skewed and the string isn't right either.
artReview.action: Retain Ysabet. Rebuild bow with coherent symmetric limb geometry, central grip and a continuous tip-to-tip string; ensure the bow remains in front of the body.

cards.name: High Cut
cards.effect: 0.9U sword cut tagged High. Opening Low may be consumed for 30% armour penetration without re-priming; otherwise establish High after contact.

cards.name: Low Answer
cards.effect: 1.1U sword cut tagged Low. Opening High may be consumed for half-armour penetration without re-priming; otherwise establish Low after contact.

cards.name: Same Road Cut
cards.effect: 0.8U sword cut: choose High or Low before contact. If tag matches opening Line, consume Line for Guard after contact instead of re-priming it. If different, establish new Line; no penetration rider.

cards.name: Cross the Bridge
cards.effect: 8% Ward and clear one eligible self-debuff. Optional consume Line for 12% Ward instead of cleansing; no Line re-priming.

cards.name: Centre Line
cards.effect: 1.4U sword thrust, neither High nor Low. Consume opening Line for next-action Exposed; otherwise retain Line. This is a held sword, not a new polearm.

cards.name: Empty Scabbard
cards.effect: 0.5U sword cut. Freely clear Line to gain one Poise after contact, or retain it and gain Guard; no same-action line creation.

cards.name: Cut the Toll
cards.effect: 1.2U sword cut. Consume Line to remove a bounded share of enemy Ward/shield: at most 0.5U shield points under one action budget; without shield choose 30% armour penetration instead.

cards.name: Take the Lower Road
cards.effect: Heal 5% HP and Guard. Consume Line to clear one eligible self-debuff instead of Guard; no additional damage.

cards.name: The Road Goes On
cards.effect: 1.7U sword cut: choose High or Low. Consume opposite Line for half-armour penetration, same Line for 10% Ward, or retain Line for neither rider. No re-priming. Available from third H.

cards.name: Road Memory
cards.effect: Every second chosen Attack establishes selected High or Low Line after contact if none exists. The choice is attached to Attack, not a fourth combat action. A consuming Attack cannot prime a new Line.

cards.name: Same Road
cards.effect: A signature High/Low cut with matching opening Line may consume it for Guard after contact, replacing all other token riders and suppressing re-priming. cards.effect: Attack may pay one Poise and consume opening Line for 30% armour penetration, or 8% Ward instead. Retaining Line gives neither; same Attack never re-primes it.

cards.effect: 1.2U arrow and one-F Pin. Consume step two/three for one Stun attempt instead of Pin; rejected control still loses Cadence.

cards.effect: 1.7U arrow. Consume step two for half-armour penetration or step three for +0.25U direct power. With zero/one, baseline; no finisher deadlock. Available from third H.

cards.effect: 0.5U sword cut and establish Watch after contact. No immediate control or information about future enemy moves.

cards.name: Shuttered Light
cards.effect: 8% Ward and Guard through next move. Consume Watch for 12% Ward instead of Guard; sacrifices charge-interruption setup.

cards.name: A Place to Stand
cards.effect: Attack may pay one Vigil and consume Watch for 8% Ward; with opening Answer, consume it too for 10% Ward instead. Same Attack cannot establish a new Watch.

guides.title: Choose the answer
guides.feel: An elderly gatekeeper who prepares a Watch and chooses between contesting a visible charge, a penetrating strike and a safe release. He cannot predict the next enemy move.
guides.choice: Use the listed preparation, then choose the damaging or protective release. The setup is spent once; the three selected slots cannot access unselected signatures.

cards.name: Take Watch
cards.effect: 0.5U sword cut and establish Watch after contact. No immediate control or information about future enemy moves.

cards.name: Gatepost Cut
cards.effect: 1.3U sword cut. Consume Watch plus optional Answer for next-action Exposed; with Answer also gain 6% Ward after contact. No automatic counter or immediate extra action.

cards.name: Kept Vigil
cards.effect: Every third chosen Attack establishes Watch if absent. The first whole enemy move fully defended manually during each Watch banks Answer once per establishment, even if resource is capped. Refreshing Watch does not reset eligibility.

Warrior.name: Heavy Strike
Warrior.meta: active, CD3 · shared class tool · cost 0 native resource · timed
Warrior.effect: 1.2U physical held-weapon hit. Optionally consume one source-labelled authored Opening for +0.2U aggregate direct power, replacing that Opening’s signature/held-charge payout; never both. With no Opening, useful baseline. One pooled ring/grade, default +0.15U Perfect within the common optional modifier ceiling; no additional status stack or per-packet refund.

Warrior.name: Cleave
Warrior.meta: active, CD3 · shared class tool · cost 0 native resource
Warrior.effect: Standard held-weapon hit, two Bleed. One enemy; a wide swing does not invent extra targets.

Warrior.name: Sunder
Warrior.meta: active, CD4 · shared class tool · cost 0 native resource
Warrior.effect: Standard hit, halves armour reduction for two enemy opportunities; does not reduce elemental resistance.

Warrior.name: Brace
Warrior.meta: active, CD4 · shared class tool · cost 1 native resource
Warrior.effect: Guard across two actual enemy attacks, resource-priced exception to one-move default, with a maximum three-F timeout. First wholly manually defended attack during it establishes one two-H shared Opening; any Parry/Dodge mix qualifies. Refresh never rearms eligibility.

Warrior.name: Lunge
Warrior.meta: active, CD3 · shared class tool · cost 0 native resource
Warrior.effect: Standard contact; modest Speed benefit for two hero opportunities. No extra immediate turn; respect consecutive-action caps.

Warrior.name: Momentum
Warrior.effect: Every third consecutive basic Attack gains a draft 15% direct action bonus, then resets the count. An active breaks the streak; counter/Star damage neither advances nor breaks it. Works in a three-passive kit.

Ranger.name: Power Strike
Ranger.meta: active, CD3 · shared class tool · cost 0; optional 1 for penetration native resource · timed
Ranger.effect: Heavy precision hit; voluntarily spend one resource for half-armour penetration. Wren's name stays Power Shot. One pooled ring/grade, default +0.15U Perfect within the common optional modifier ceiling; no additional status stack or per-packet refund.

Ranger.name: Barbed Strike
Ranger.meta: active, CD3 · shared class tool · cost 0 native resource
Ranger.effect: Light hit and two Bleed. Blade wound or arrow barb; held equipment never leaves the hand.

Ranger.name: Pinning Strike
Ranger.meta: active, CD4 · shared class tool · cost 0 native resource
Ranger.effect: Standard hit; next enemy move has wider Parry and Dodge windows. No automatic reaction.

Ranger.name: Quarry Mark
Ranger.meta: active, CD4 · shared class tool · cost 0 native resource
Ranger.effect: Light hit, three-enemy-opportunity Mark. Not a permanent passive damage bonus.

Ranger.name: Flurry
Ranger.meta: active, CD4 · shared class tool · cost 1 native resource · timed
Ranger.effect: Three packets with a fixed total and one action timing grade/crit/proc budget. Wren's display name is Volley. One pooled ring/grade, default +0.15U Perfect within the common optional modifier ceiling; no additional status stack or per-packet refund.

Ranger.name: Twin Strike
Ranger.effect: Basic Attack gains a draft 15% total direct-damage budget, expressed as two packets sharing that total; one resource gain and one Star trigger budget. The selected slot buys the bonus, not doubled proc income. Wren's name stays Twin Shot.

Mage.name: Spark
Mage.meta: active, CD2 · shared class tool · cost 0 native resource
Mage.effect: Quick standard spell; gain one native hero-resource unit. Type/visual follow the caster's authored focus.

Mage.name: Frost Shard
Mage.meta: active, CD3 · shared class tool · cost 1 native resource · timed
Mage.effect: Standard frost spell, two Chill; the shared control lock applies. A spell effect, not thrown glass/ice equipment. One pooled ring/grade, default +0.15U Perfect within the common optional modifier ceiling; no additional status stack or per-packet refund.

Mage.name: Arcane Ward
Mage.meta: active, CD4 · shared class tool · cost 1 native resource
Mage.effect: 12% maximum-HP Ward for two F, explicit shorter-duration exception to the three-F default. Greater remaining amount wins; refreshing never rearms a status-block eligibility.

Mage.name: Hex
Mage.meta: active, CD4 · shared class tool · cost 1 native resource
Mage.effect: Apply one source-labelled Hex Curse for three F, replacing any existing Curse and discarding storage, maturity and unused eligibility. Stores 20% eligible actual direct HP damage capped at 0.6U; excludes DoTs, counters, Stars and derived payouts. Natural expiry releases storage once as derived damage, then clears. It cannot mature a Mab Curse or earn Mab’s source-specific passive rewards.

Mage.name: Nova
Mage.meta: active, CD4 · shared class tool · cost 2 native resource
Mage.effect: 1U holy spell. Optional release chooses either one tick from each of up to two different authored Burn/Bleed/Venom kinds for total derived damage capped 0.4U, or one source-labelled Curse for its existing capped derived storage. Clear sources before contact. Curse consumption also clears Mab maturity/eligibility; no second crit, storage or amplification. Only one derived payout this action.

Mage.name: Afterglow
Mage.effect: A directly selected damaging spell active primes the next chosen basic Attack for +20% direct action damage within two subsequent H. Attack consumes the token and never rearms it. Stored arrivals, passive/generated packets and Star/counter hits cannot trigger it; this shared passive deliberately requires an equipped damaging active.

Ready Lamp.name: Ready Lamp
Ready Lamp.effect: Begin with one native resource unit. Opening grant does not count as generated/spent income.

Spark Guard.name: Spark Guard
Spark Guard.effect: Once per wholly defended enemy move, gain one resource. Any successful mix of Parry/Dodge qualifies; not per hit.

Turning Point.name: Turning Point
Turning Point.effect: Once/fight, crossing one-third foe HP primes the first direct packet of the next damaging active for a sure crit. No whole-volley crit engine.

Hunter's Step.name: Hunter's Step
Hunter's Step.effect: A full Dodge extends existing authored Mark by one enemy opportunity, under cap. It neither creates nor re-arms a fresh-Mark engine.

Serrated.name: Serrated
Serrated.effect: First direct crit/action adds one Bleed only if already Bleeding. A bridge, not a complete wound kit from generic crit chance.

Cold Steel.name: Cold Steel
Cold Steel.effect: Once per wholly defended enemy move, if the foe already has authored Chill, add one Chill. No free frost engine without a frost choice.

Quick Return.name: Quick Return
Quick Return.effect: Once per wholly defended move, reduce the **last used active's** remaining cooldown by one. No all-cooldown reset or extra opportunity.

Ember Edge.name: Ember Edge
Ember Edge.effect: First direct crit/action extends an existing authored Burn by one tick, under cap. Does not create fire.

Open Veins.name: Open Veins
Open Veins.effect: One aggregate natural Bleed tick can crit. DoT crits do not trigger direct-hit effects or raise Curse storage twice.

Brand.name: Brand
Brand.effect: Fresh authored ignition on an unburning foe gives short Mark, once/action. Refresh is not ignition; this Mark has Star origin.

Slip and Strike.name: Slip and Strike
Slip and Strike.effect: After fully dodging a move, next damaging active gains a modest action-wide bonus. One token, not one bonus for each dodged hit.

Dazed Prey.name: Dazed Prey
Dazed Prey.effect: First accepted control/action adds a short Mark. On bosses, accepted Stagger contribution qualifies; rejected/locked attempts do not.

Killing Mark.name: Killing Mark
Killing Mark.effect: First direct ability crit/action on authored Mark gains a modest bonus. No critical DoT or sure-crit stacking multiplier.

Encore.name: Encore
Encore.effect: Third **different** active used each fight refunds one cooldown turn to itself, once/fight, minimum one. Three casts of one ability do not qualify.

Bloodscent.name: Bloodscent
Bloodscent.effect: Authored consumption of Bleed grants one resource, once/action. Natural ticks alone do not generate perpetual income.

Spite.name: Spite
Spite.effect: Once/enemy move, surviving positive residual direct HP damage primes a stronger next Attack. No income for Ward-only hits or hero DoT.

Evil Eye.name: Evil Eye
Evil Eye.effect: The first authored Curse application/action adds brief Weaken, not permanent Mark. Refreshing Curse does not qualify.

Ringing Blow.name: Ringing Blow
Ringing Blow.effect: First accepted control/action adds modest boss Stagger; ordinary foes do not receive a second skip. Respect control lock.

Frostfire.name: Frostfire
Frostfire.effect: A damaging fire action spending at least two resource adds one Chill, once/action. Gross spend before refunds; resource name is irrelevant.

Riptide.name: Riptide
Riptide.effect: A full Dodge grants Return: next chosen Attack adds a bounded bonus. No automatic counter, free second hit or true-counter trigger.

Swift Tide.name: Swift Tide
Swift Tide.effect: First resource-spending active/fight reduces its own cooldown by one after resolution, floor one. Does not remove an authored finisher gate.

Cinder Riposte.name: Cinder Riposte
Cinder Riposte.effect: A true full-Parry counter against an already burning foe extends that authored Burn once/move. Cannot supply a whole fire kit by itself.

Open Guard.name: Open Guard
Open Guard.effect: Finish a wholly defended move while authored Guard holds; prime one Opening for next Attack/heavy active. Both defence styles qualify.

Perfect Time.name: Perfect Time
Perfect Time.effect: One Perfect offensive timing grade/action reduces one other selected cooldown by one. Predetermined target priority, no refund cascade across all skills.

Banked Coal.name: Banked Coal
Banked Coal.effect: A directly selected active spending at least two gross authored resource units refunds one after resolution. Passive Attack/Star/reservation spends never qualify. Merge with timing/ability refunds under the one-unit/actually-spent cap.

Crushing Blow.name: Crushing Blow
Crushing Blow.effect: Every fourth Attack **action** gains a modest direct action bonus. Twin attacks count once.

Brimming.name: Brimming
Brimming.effect: Authored income that would overflow grants one Overflow token/action or enemy move. Next chosen Attack cashes it for a small bonus; no repeated direct damage flushes.

Mending Steel.name: Mending Steel
Mending Steel.effect: First authored Guard to naturally expire/fight heals a small bounded amount through the normal heal path. Refresh/replacement does not qualify.

Avalanche.name: Avalanche
Avalanche.effect: A heavy active spending at least half native resource cap, rounded up, makes one control attempt. Merge with an existing attempt; gross spend before refunds.

Full Draw.name: Full Draw
Full Draw.effect: At cap, a precision active may commit one unit for its one direct-budget sure crit, or half cap rounded up for armour penetration. Choose one before its own cost; decline an unaffordable combination. Star commitment is not authored card spend.

Kindling.name: Kindling
Kindling.effect: One aggregate natural Burn tick can crit. Not one roll per refreshed burn component, no direct-hit proc.

Stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
Stoneskin.effect: While authored Guard holds, first HP-damaging hit/move may spend one resource to mitigate a bounded share. No spend if Ward absorbed it all.

Scarred.name: Scarred
Scarred.effect: An active consuming authored Mark adds one Bleed after contact, once/action. Star Bleed does not trigger another Star.

Last Light.name: Last Light
Last Light.effect: Once/fight, one lethal direct hit leaves 1 HP. Later hits/DoT still threaten; no invulnerability interval.

Blood Price.name: Blood Price
Blood Price.effect: Below half HP, the next chosen Attack/heavy active gains a bounded bonus once/hero opportunity. No damage-over-time/reflect amplification or automatic heal. Optional risk, not a subclass requirement.

Holy Sparks.name: Holy Sparks
Holy Sparks.effect: Fully defending while an authored Ward holds primes a small holy rider on next Attack, once/move. One chosen action, no per-parried-hit projectile.

Shatterpoint.name: Shatterpoint
Shatterpoint.effect: Breaking a charge primes the next tagged heavy action. One break event, no immediate fake counter or defensive-counter rewards.

Deep Wounds.name: Deep Wounds
Deep Wounds.effect: Authored Bleed's cap rises from five to seven; expiry unchanged. Extra stacks require real applications; no granted bleed or extra tick events.

Tripwire.name: Tripwire
Tripwire.effect: First enemy move has modestly wider Parry and Dodge windows. Never selects defence or skips the foe.

Snare.name: Snare
Snare.effect: Accepted control against an already Pinned foe extends the Pin once/action; bosses need an accepted Stagger contribution. No fresh hard-control loop.

Witchfire.name: Witchfire
Witchfire.effect: Authored Curse burst extends existing authored Burn by one tick, under cap. Does not create Burn or propagate a Star chain.

Sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
Sanctuary.effect: Begin with one small Ward. Greater remaining shield wins; Star Ward does not prime authored-Ward class/hero engines.

Thermal Shock.name: Thermal Shock
Thermal Shock.effect: First fire active against authored Chill gets a bounded action bonus and consumes one Chill after resolution. No tick-triggered repetition.

Close Quarters.name: Close Quarters
Close Quarters.effect: A tagged melee spender at resource cap grants one-opportunity Guard after contact. No Ward, extra attack or proc on retained units.

Long Sight.name: Long Sight
Long Sight.effect: First basic Attack on authored Mark each hero opportunity ignores a small portion of armour. A basic-attack route distinct from Killing Mark.

Clean Break.name: Clean Break
Clean Break.effect: One action consuming two **different authored status kinds** primes its next active for a modest bonus. Consuming two Bleed stacks is not two kinds.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.effect: First full Dodge/fight clears one hero DoT via normal cleanse rules. No heal, no repeated multi-hit cleanses.

Tempered Edge.name: Tempered Edge
Tempered Edge.effect: A resource-spending defensive active primes next Attack with a small holy rider. Makes a deliberate protective investment useful offensively.

Unspent Light.name: Unspent Light
Unspent Light.effect: Once/fight, a spender may retain one unit **instead of** refunding it. Retained unit does not contribute to payoff or gross-spend thresholds. Visible choice before commitment.

Patient Flame.name: Patient Flame
Patient Flame.effect: Burn reaching its second natural tick without refresh primes the next fire active. One prime per application; extending duration is a refresh and restarts observation.

Winter Glass.name: Winter Glass
Winter Glass.effect: First accepted Freeze/fight grants a small Ward. No shield on rejected control; Ward has Star origin.

Deep Rime.name: Deep Rime
Deep Rime.effect: When accepted Freeze naturally resolves, restore one Chill once/application. Star Chill cannot trigger Cold Steel or another Star; no immediate refreeze.

Splintered Guard.name: Splintered Guard
Splintered Guard.effect: Once/fight, a resource-spending heavy active may sacrifice remaining authored Ward for bounded penetration. Bonus scales with remaining shield under a fixed ceiling. Decline to keep protection. Sacrifice is not a break and triggers no break/expiry engine.

Candle Debt.name: Candle Debt
Candle Debt.effect: An authored Curse naturally expiring grants one resource. Early detonation does not; a genuine hold-versus-release choice.

Final Word.name: Final Word
Final Word.effect: A chosen Attack may replace its normal damage with the pending authored Curse's stored burst. Clear Curse first and forgo ordinary Attack income/riders; alternatively Attack normally and let it mature. One stored release, no second crit/mitigation/other-Star trigger.

Clear Conscience.name: Clear Conscience
Clear Conscience.effect: Casting an authored cleanse while Cursed grants a small Ward once/fight. Cleansing a non-Curse status does not qualify; no automatic cleanse.

Measured Beat.name: Measured Beat
Measured Beat.effect: Completing Attack → active → Attack grants one resource on the final action, once/sequence. Counters/secondary effects neither advance nor form sequences.

Offbeat.name: Offbeat
Offbeat.effect: After the enemy resolves consecutive opportunities, next Attack gains a bounded bonus, once/move-sequence. No extra turn or timeline rewind.

Still Water.name: Still Water
Still Water.effect: First wholly defended move while an authored Ward holds gives one resource, once/cast of the Ward. Not once for every hit.

Red Thread.name: Red Thread
Red Thread.effect: Authored consumption of Bleed leaves one weak Bleed stack behind. It adds no consumed damage and cannot trigger another Star.

Black Salt.name: Black Salt
Black Salt.effect: Second natural authored Venom tick applies brief Weaken once/application. Refresh restarts the counter; Star Weaken cannot power another Star.

Bitter Harvest.name: Bitter Harvest
Bitter Harvest.effect: Actively consuming authored Venom grants a small heal once/fight. Amount capped and routed through normal healing; no per-stack heal.

Antidote.name: Antidote
Antidote.effect: First authored heal while the hero is Poisoned/fight also cleanses that Poison. A hero without heal must choose a real source; Stars do not supply it for free.

Distant Thunder.name: Distant Thunder
Distant Thunder.effect: Three basic Attacks prime next tagged heavy active for better authored charge-break contribution. No automatic break or extra direct damage packet.

Aftershock.name: Aftershock
Aftershock.effect: First direct chosen action against a control-locked foe gains a bounded bonus. Does not attempt control or shorten lock. One trigger per lock interval.

Grounded Lightning.name: Grounded Lightning
Grounded Lightning.effect: A true full-Parry counter primes next Attack's resource gain by one. One per move, cannot turn that Attack into another true counter.

Hollow Prism.name: Hollow Prism
Hollow Prism.effect: After an elemental damaging spell, next Attack may take its element or clear the token for one resource while staying normal type. Both consume it. No copied status, extra hit or synthetic income chain.

Kindred Embers.name: Kindred Embers
Kindred Embers.effect: First authored action against a foe carrying two different authored DoT kinds gains a bounded direct bonus. One trigger per hero opportunity; Stars cannot create its prerequisites.

Pilgrim's Guard.name: Pilgrim's Guard
Pilgrim's Guard.effect: First non-damaging defensive active/fight primes next basic Attack with a small bonus. Ordinary Attack builds can invest one utility slot without a damage rotation.

Lamp at Dusk.name: Lamp at Dusk
Lamp at Dusk.effect: First authored heal made below half HP/fight primes next damaging active. No benefit from overheal, passive between-fight healing or a Star's heal.

Quiet Oath.name: Quiet Oath
Quiet Oath.effect: Two consecutive basic Attacks without resource spend grant a small Ward once/fight. No permanent Attack-to-shield refill; the actions must actually resolve.

Open Sky.name: Open Sky
Open Sky.effect: First authored cleanse/fight primes next directly damaging active for modest armour/resistance penetration. Does not trigger from another Star's cleanse.

subclassPaths: A wholly defended move while authored Guard/Ward holds grants one Shelter token; next chosen Attack can spend it for an offensive bonus. Once/move, both defence styles work.
Brace can grant a small Ward after the defended move, once/cast. Sunder may trade part of its damage for one enemy opportunity of Weaken.
A gross signature expenditure or the third consecutive basic Attack grants Edge of Battle: the next chosen basic Attack adds one Bleed. One token, no hit-taking requirement.
Cleave can consume part of existing Bleed for immediate derived damage. Heavy Strike can trade Opening's damage bonus for a short Guard after contact.
First authored resource-spending directly damaging active per hero opportunity adds one Venom; visible five-stack/tick ceiling. Genuine poison, not a renamed Bleed modifier.
Barbed Strike can apply Venom instead of Bleed. Quarry Mark can trade duration for a Venom payoff; neither creates a second poison packet per hit.
Fully defending a move earns Route: next Attack Pins the foe. One token, mixed Parry/Dodge permitted.
Pinning Strike can trade some damage for one-opportunity Guard. Lunge-equivalent Footwork variant of Power Strike trades heavy damage for standard damage and modest Speed.
Alternating damage types, or spell → Attack, primes a modest follow-up bonus. One per action; same-type spam does not earn it.
Frost Shard may consume one Burn tick for a bounded frost payoff. Nova can use the previous spell's damage type instead of holy, without copying its status payload.
An authored Ward naturally ending/breaking gives Warmth: next chosen Attack/spell has a bounded offensive bonus. One token; not reflected damage.
Arcane Ward can trade size for blocking one incoming status. Spark can trade some damage for a small Ward after its hit.
